svg.title: Four composable statuslines, grouped by checkout
svg.desc: Illustrative terminal footer with blue full-path and branch pills first, related pull requests and issues on each checkout row, and one overall subagent summary below. Star, plus, and percent mean unstaged, staged, and untracked changes. Explicit target refs have up and down arrows for ahead and behind counts; the base target shows missing commits only. Counts use locally fetched refs, not a network freshness guarantee.

g.text: Know which checkout the session is working in.
Feature labels identify each component. Pill backgrounds show its current status.
Full checkout path, branch, and divergence.
Checks and reviews; open on GitHub.
1 local-only commit; 2 upstream commits missing locally (diverged).
3 base commits missing. Known but unavailable target: origin/main? · Zero counts are hidden.
Example: labels and outlines identify features. Pill fills show status. Counts use local refs; fetch normally to update them.
